text:
Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Ally Financial Has Increased Its Stake in Apple (AAPL) by $9.30 Million as Market Valuation Declined; Jw Asset Management Decreased Its Position in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) as Valuation Rose
May 16, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Jw Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jw Asset Management Llc sold 7,250 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 17,750 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.06 million, down from 25,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jw Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $505.19 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.02% or $2.03 during the last trading session, reaching $196.61. About 12.69 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Ally Financial Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 137.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ally Financial Inc bought 55,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 95,000 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.08 million, up from 40,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ally Financial Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $916.38B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.91% or $1.71 during the last trading session, reaching $186.44. About 21.16 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Analysts await Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) to report earnings on August, 16. They expect $1.16 earnings per share, up 23.40% or $0.22 from last year’s $0.94 per share. BABA’s profit will be $2.98B for 42.37 P/E if the $1.16 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.54 actual earnings per share reported by Alibaba Group Holding Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 114.81% EPS growth.
